quality: Compression quality (higher CRF: smaller file, less detail)
intro: Process files you own or have permission to edit. The original file on your device is not changed.
help: Choose the required files, check their information, select settings and process. Review and download the output before expiry.
failure: Processing failed. Check the input and settings, or try a shorter file.
limits: Input/output size, duration and processing time limits apply. Files are stored privately and deleted after expiry.
order: Select files in the required order. For a watermark or subtitles, select the video first and the supporting file second.
faqA: No. Processing uses an uploaded copy and creates a separate output. Keep your original file.
error.size: The input or output exceeds the file size limit. Try a smaller file.
error.duration: The media exceeds the duration or image dimension limit.
error.capacity: Processing capacity is limited. Try a smaller file or try again later.
error.codec: The required codec is unavailable. Choose another format.
error.timeout: Processing timed out or reached its CPU limit. Try a shorter file.
error.unavailable: This operation is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error.output: Output could not be generated. Check the input and settings.
error.invalid: Choose a valid, supported, nonempty media file.
error.expired: This file expired. Upload it again.
error.settings: Check the selected files, their order and processing settings.
error.audio: This operation requires an audio track.
error.subtitles: A compatible embedded text subtitle track is required.
error.network: The upload or connection failed. Please try again.
